name: family-chronicle
description: Linked timeline and map built from a GEDCOM family tree, with historical context events.

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('build',{recursive:true})" && npm run map && npm run parse && python scripts/build.py
scripts.build:demo: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('build',{recursive:true})" && npm run map && npm run parse:demo && python scripts/build.py
